 Order
This order shall govern the disposal of both the aforesaid applications.

2. These are the second applications filed by the applicants under Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR/Crime No.10/2024 dated 03.01.2024 registered at Police Station Kareli District Narsinghpur for the offence under Sections 419, 420, 409 and 467 of IPC.
3. As per the case of the prosecution, applicants Nitesh Kamble and Arvind Kumar Arya are bank employees.
the First Information Report has been lodged on the basis of complaint filed by complainant Sannu Bhariya S/o Suklu Bhariya in which he stated that his wife Sukrati Bhariya died in 2013.

Father of his wife had given 10 acres of land to the complainant's wife and the said land situated on Khasra No.2/20, 2/11, 8/7 and 16 Area 1.619 hectares, 1.214 hectares, 0.809 hectares,
0.372 hectares total 4.014 hectares were recorded in the name of his wife.

After the death of his wife,
when the complainant made attempt to seek mutation of Khasra entries, he came to know that on the property, a mortgage dated 23.01.2023 was recorded.

Thereafter, the complainant met the field officer of the Union Bank who informed the complainant that his wife, while mortgaging the said land, had availed a Cash Credit Loan facility of Rs.7,60,000/-.
The complainant informed the concerned field officer that no loan was ever availed by his wife, still the field officer insisted that the complainant would have to repay the loan.

Thereafter, complainant came back to his village and found that the land which was belonging to deceased/wife of the complainant, was mortgaged by one Sukrati Bai W/o Rajbali Bhariya and when the said matter was agitated before the Panchayat,
Sukrati Bai W/o Rajbali appeared before the Panchayat and admitted that she had availed a Mudra loan and had received Rs.1,00,000/-.

Later on, it was found that the present applicants along with one Golu @ Gajendra Katiya entered into a conspiracy and while obtaining thumb impression of Sukrati Bai W/o Rajbali Bhariya, a loan of Rs.7,60,000/- was sanctioned and withdrawn.

4. Shri Ajay Jain, counsel for the applicant, namely Nitesh Kamble and Shri Manish Datt, Senior counsel with Shri Amardeep Seth, counsel for the applicant-Arvind Kumar Arya contend that it is not disputed that the loan has been availed by Sukrati D/o Bhura.
In the present case, the name of father of the complainant's deceased wife as well as Sukrati Bai who has availed the Cash Credit Loan is Bhura only.

It is contended by the counsels that the before processing the case of Sukrati D/o Bhura Bhariya, loan documents were processed and after due verification of the same, the loan Arvind Kumar Arya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91229197/
2 in question was released in favour of Sukrati Bai D/o Bhura Bhariya.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsels for the both the applicants submit that previous applications on behalf of applicants were dismissed by this Court while observing that Sukrati Bai was illiterate and she was made scapegoat in furtherance of commission of the offence.

It is contended by the counsels that subsequently documents have been obtained in order to demonstrate that Sukrati Bai is working as Anganwadi Karyakarta and is educated and apart from the loan transaction in question the other loan facility has also been availed by Sukratibai.

It is also contended by Shri Manish Datt, Senior Advocate for the applicant that applicant is Bank Manager and he did not play any role, inasmuch as, it is the duty of Rural Development Officer to process the loan and in support of submission documents have also been brought on record.
Apart from above submissions both the counsels submit that incarceration of the present applicant would give rise to disciplinary action against the applicants.
Therefore, submit that present applicants are ready and willing to deposit the defalcated amount under protest.
There is no probability of their absconding or tampering with the evidence of prosecution.
Conclusion of trial will take long time, therefore, it is prayed to grant anticipatory bail to the applicants.
5. Per contra, counsel for the State submits that the applications are liable to be dismissed.

Counsel contends that previously the bail applications were duly considered by this Court and this Court after dealing with the entire submission of the counsels for applicants ultimately rejected the bail application.
It is also contended by the counsel that under the garb of present applications there is an attempt by the applicants to seek review of the earlier order.
Hence, submits that applications deserve to be dismissed.

6. Heard the rival submissions of both the parties and perused the record.
7.
Though on previous occasion the matter was argued at length and this Court after hearing the parties elaborately, dismissed the previous applications.

However, as now the applicants have expressed their willingness to deposit 50% of the defalcated amount, thus considering the aforesaid concession so given by the applicants, this Court deem it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on anticipatory bail on the following conditions.

8. It is directed that subject to deposit of 50% amount (Rs.3,50,000/-) by Nitesh Kumble and 50%
amount (Rs.3,50,000/-) by Arvind Kumar Arya

, in the event of arrest, applicants Nitesh Kumble and Arvind Kumar Arya shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) each with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for their appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.
9.
It is made clear that only upon deposit of 50% of the amount as mentioned in above paragraph the present applicants shall be enlarged on bail.

10. It is further directed that the applicants shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE VKT Arvind Kumar Arya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91229197/
